schema.title: Response List Classes Api Classes Get

get.description: The one call the hub needs: may I play, how long is left, when does it reset.

post.description:
End a game for good. The learner keeps no result and loses no seat.

One call covers every game mode: a solo attempt, a challenge turn, and —
from Phase 8 — a live match, where ending the session is also what tells
the other end to close its socket.

get.description: The coach's table: every learner, the time they have, any pause on them.

One level of words this learner may play with no connection (P9-T02).

The learner is the scope: the band comes from their birthday, so a client
cannot ask for a younger child's words. What comes back is content only.
Games a learner may open. Disabled games are not listed at all.

schema.title: Response Catalog Api Games Catalog Get

get.description: The session a refreshed tab should return to, if there is one.

post.description:
Open a session and start its clock. Refuses if one is already open.

Generic by design: Phase 6 and Phase 8 add games to the registry, not
endpoints to this file.

get.description: State for a refreshed tab, including the time left this instant.

post.description: One move. A repeated ``client_move_id`` returns the same state.

schema.title: Response List Limits Api Games Limits Get
Response List Lockouts Api Games Lockouts Get

get.description: Classmates you can tap to invite (P7-T06: avatars first).

schema.title: Response Friends Api Games Friends Get

post.description: Open a challenge and invite somebody: a roster tap, a code, a link.
Start your own attempt at a challenge: the normal play state follows.

get.description: The challenges you still owe a turn in, so a closed tab loses nothing.

schema.title: Response My Challenges Api Games Challenges Mine Get

get.description:
The one sentence the end screen shows: who you played, and who won.

``null`` means this was a solo game, not a challenge, which is the common
case and costs one request when the game ends.

schema.title: Response Challenge Result Api Games Sessions  Session Id  Challenge Get

post.description: Claim a seat by inbox row, typed code, or link token.

Consume the link token the join page left in an httpOnly cookie.

The cookie is cleared whatever happens: a token is good once, and leaving it
behind would make the next sign-in on a shared laptop join a stranger's game.
"No thanks" — a decline is silent, like a block (never a notification).

get.description: Pending invites and challenge news. No email, no SMS (P7-T07).

post.description: Block or mute. The other learner is never told (P7-T08).

get.description: The school admin's list. P10 deepens the workflow, not this endpoint.

schema.title: Response List Reports Api Games Reports Get

post.description: The minimum report: a reason, an optional note, and the admin's list.
Open a match and invite somebody (P8-T09).
Take the second seat, by inbox row, code, or link.

get.description: A refreshed tab's snapshot, including clocks and whose turn it is.

post.description: Mark this player present without a socket (the REST fallback).
The same call the socket makes, for a tab whose socket is down.
A new match with the same pair, colours swapped (P8-T13).

get.description: Classmates you may challenge, with a reason when you may not (P8-T04).

schema.title: Response Presence Api Games Presence Get

post.description: One socket, one match, thirty seconds (P8-T01).

get.description: The groups a pack can be written for, youngest first.

schema.title: Response Age Bands Api Content Age Bands Get

get.description:
The band most of this coach's learners are in, so the screen can pre-pick it.

Advisory only: the client still sends an explicit ``age_band`` when it makes
a list, and any other band remains one tap away.

schema.title: Response Suggested Band Api Content Suggested Band Get

get.description: Every version of every pack, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Packs Api Content Packs Get

post.description: A new draft version, optionally seeded with an existing pack's words.
``answer, clue, level`` per line, with a line-by-line report.
Make one word live. The only door to the games.
Take one live word out of the games. Nothing is deleted.
Make every ready draft word live at once, skipping any that still fail.

get.description: How many packs sit in each status, for the queue header.

schema.title: Response Summary Api Content Summary Get

get.description: Every word that cannot be used, and where it came from.

schema.title: Response Blocked Words Api Content Blocked Words Get

post.description: Add a word. It is refused from the next save onwards, with no deploy.

delete.description: Undo a school's own addition. Built-in entries are refused.

get.description:
Streak, today's quest, badges, bests and the level ring — one call.

Everything here is derived from results the server wrote; the browser has no
way to add a day to the streak or finish a quest itself.
The caller's own row, even when they are outside the top ten.
A coach's class with each learner's XP split by game (P5-T11).

schema.title: Response List Terms Api School Terms Get

post.description: Term dates are the school admin's to set; the termly board needs them.

schema.title: Response Seed Learning Xp Api Testing Learning Xp Post

AdminReportOut.title: AdminReportOut
AdminReportOut.description: The school admin's list also shows who is who, in plain names (P7-T09).

BadgeOut.title: BadgeOut
BadgeOut.description: A badge is a gameplay fact; ``earned_on`` is null until it is theirs.

BoardChaseOut.title: BoardChaseOut
BoardChaseOut.description: The learner one place above: the near-miss nudge.

BoardEntryOut.title: BoardEntryOut
BoardEntryOut.description: Masked identity only: preferred name and avatar (D-15).

ChallengeResultOut.title: ChallengeResultOut
ChallengeResultOut.description:
One player's own challenge, for their end screen (P7-T05).

No secret reaches this shape: no seed, no word, no other score until both
attempts are in (D-25).

FriendOut.title: FriendOut
FriendOut.description: One avatar in the "play with a friend" sheet (P7-T06).

InviteAcceptedOut.title: InviteAcceptedOut
InviteAcceptedOut.description:
Where the accepted seat is. A challenge has a parent to start; a live
match is already the thing you join, so it has no parent (P8-T09).

LevelOut.title: LevelOut
LevelOut.description: Presentational only — never a grade, never an eligibility input.

LiveStateOut.title: LiveStateOut
LiveStateOut.description: One player's view of a match: no seed, no opponent legal moves (D-25).

LoginIn.title: LoginIn
LoginIn.description:
A student code and a PIN (0003_login_codes).

Validation is deliberately loose about *format* and strict about length:
rejecting a well-formed-but-unknown code here would tell an attacker which
codes exist, and it would tell a child nothing useful.

MeXpOut.title: MeXpOut
MeXpOut.description: Profile XP is presentation only: no grade or badge may read it (P5-T05).

MyTurnOut.title: MyTurnOut
MyTurnOut.description: A challenge where this learner still owes a turn (P7-T06).

OfflineItemOut.title: OfflineItemOut
OfflineItemOut.description:
One downloadable puzzle.

This is the only response that carries an answer, and only because an
offline round has no server to check against. It carries no session and no
seed, so a downloaded word can never be scored or ranked (P9-T02).

PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
PublicProfile.description: Everything another learner may ever see. Add fields with care.

RoundOut.title: RoundOut
RoundOut.description:
One round, whichever game it belongs to.

The two games fill different halves of this model, and neither ever carries
an answer or a secret: Word Scramble sends letters and a clue (P4-T10),
Number Guess sends the window and how many tries are left (P6-T03).

SelfProfile.title: SelfProfile
SelfProfile.description: The caller's own account, shown only to them.

StreakOut.title: StreakOut
StreakOut.description: Consecutive school-local days with a finished game (P6 engagement).

StudentGameXpOut.title: StudentGameXpOut
StudentGameXpOut.description: One game inside a learner's breakdown (P5-T11).

StudentXpOut.title: StudentXpOut
StudentXpOut.description:
A coach's view of one learner: total plus where it came from.

Auditable by construction: the same numbers a school admin can reconcile
against the ledger. Identity stays masked (D-15).

TicketOut.title: TicketOut
TicketOut.description: A single-use key for one socket. Never logged, never stored client-side.

XpAwardOut.title: XpAwardOut
XpAwardOut.description:
The post-game summary: what this game paid, and room left today.

Awarded, not requested: a capped award shows the number the learner
actually got (P5-T10).
